_description: JSON prompt schema for Image Prompt Architect. All prompts must follow this structure. Fields marked REQUIRED must always be populated. Fields marked CONDITIONAL are added when relevant to the scene.

meta_data.task_type: REQUIRED. String. Descriptive snake_case label for this specific shot.
meta_data.version: REQUIRED. String. Collection or series label linking this prompt to the set.

input.mode: REQUIRED. One of: text_to_image, image_to_image_show_me, image_to_image_edit.
input.notes: REQUIRED. String. 2-4 sentence creative director brief. For image-to-image modes, MUST begin with 'Using the uploaded [explicit description]...'

scene.location: REQUIRED. Specific real-world or conceptual location.
scene.time: REQUIRED. Time of day and light condition.
scene.environment: REQUIRED. Minimum 3 specific environmental details: textures, atmosphere, depth, background elements, spatial character.

subjects.interaction: REQUIRED. What subjects are doing. Specific moment, not generic pose.
subjects.emotion: REQUIRED. Felt emotional quality, not adjective list.
subjects.micro_expression: REQUIRED. What eyes, mouth, brow, jaw are specifically doing.
subjects.body_language: REQUIRED. Posture, weight distribution, tension/relaxation, gestural details.

styling.subject_1: REQUIRED. Complete outfit: color + material + construction + fit for each garment. Hair. Makeup. Accessories. No vague descriptions.
styling.subject_2: CONDITIONAL. Same detail level. Include when couple or team.

camera.lens: REQUIRED. Focal length and lens character.
camera.depth_of_field: REQUIRED. Specific DOF behavior and what it isolates or reveals.
camera.framing: REQUIRED. Shot type code (ECU/CU/MCU/MS/MFS/FS/WS/EWS) plus composition details.
camera.angle: REQUIRED. Camera height and orientation relative to subject.
camera.motion: REQUIRED. Still, handheld, motion blur, implied movement.

lighting.type: REQUIRED. Source type and names of actual sources.
lighting.behavior: REQUIRED. How light interacts with subjects, surfaces, atmosphere.
lighting.skin_response: REQUIRED. How skin renders under this light. Always enforce natural texture.

color.palette: REQUIRED. Specific colors present in frame, not mood words.
color.grade: REQUIRED. Contrast, saturation, temperature, cinematic intent.

realism.faces: REQUIRED when human subjects. Always anti-AI-beauty-filter.
realism.skin: REQUIRED when skin visible. Pores, imperfections, light interaction.
realism.hands: CONDITIONAL. Finger anatomy, grip accuracy. Include when hands visible.
realism.anatomy: REQUIRED when body visible. Posture physics, weight distribution.
realism.fabric: CONDITIONAL. Material behavior: drape, compression, wrinkles.
realism.moment: REQUIRED. What makes this feel like a real photograph. Unique per prompt.
realism._scene_specific_fields: Add as needed: food, water, steam, crowd, vehicle_interior, props, glassware, screen, controllers, petals, umbrella, etc.

rules.avoid: REQUIRED. Array of strings. Minimum 8 scene-specific items. Never copy-paste across prompts.
rules._optional_rules: Add as needed: no_ring, aspect_ratio_lock, etc.

edit.type: For edit mode. One of: background_replace, styling_change, lighting_change, element_addition, element_removal, style_transfer, material_swap, time_shift, mood_shift.
edit.preserve: Array of elements to keep unchanged.
edit.integration: How changes blend with existing elements.

consistency.identity_markers: For show-me mode. Features that must remain consistent.
consistency.lighting_logic: How lighting adapts to new angle.
